notes.title: Sequel
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Dungeon Dreams 2 is in the making and now has its own Steam page!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1843470/Dungeon_Dreams_2/?beta=0

If you enjoyed the first game, you will have another chance at a similar experience in the big City of Kalmaruss as the child of your own protagonist from the first game! (no saves are needed, character creation is in-game)
I'm working super hard and will put regular updates on Patreon (https://www.patreon.com/dungeondreams) as well as all social media and Discord (https://discord.gg/uzeEqfQ).

Thank you for your time!

notes.title: Faylinn's Quest
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! 
While you wait for Dungeon Dreams 2 (up next, I promise), the Kickstarter for Faylinn’s Quest is now live and going well!
FQ is a RPG game set in the same world and will feature many recurring characters like [b]Danthienne, Alisha, Sakura, Kireina, Caecily and Phillip[/b]. Not to mention an opportunity to go back to [b]Ecallia[/b].
Keep in mind that it will be released with a NSFW hentai version, that can, however, be removed without changes to plot and gameplay.

Please share the crowdfunding campaign or support if you’re interested: 
bit.ly/37WTzI0 . 
Thank you :)

notes.title: Meet Kireina!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
meet Foxy Kireina! In this new update, Sakura's story goes on (after completing her route at the Guild) and you get to meet Kireina.
Depending on your actions:
- Sakura and Kireina may become a couple
- Both can become permanently recruitable companions
- There are romantic events for a protagonist that is interested in them
Only one sad note, this update does not keep (backwards) track if you had a romantic time with Sakura, so some dialogue options won't appear if you already went on a date with her before the update.

notes.title: Version 2.20: New game plus and post game
notes.notes:
New version is up!
This version is labelled 2.20 and includes:
- Post-game rooms with all recruitable characters and bosses in the game
- Post-game section with powerful bosses to test your best team!
- New game plus bonuses (unfortunately, for those of you who already have completed the game, it's necessary that you beat the last boss again and reach the post-game rooms)
Let me know if you find any bugs by commenting below or reaching out to: gardenofdreamsrpg@gmail.com
And I will fix them right away!
Thank you for playing Dungeon Dreams and have fun!
